consequence.statement: With ingress-nginx >=1.8.0 with strict-validate-path-type enabled (default in >=1.12.0), the admission webhook denies the HTTP01 challenge Ingress, so cert-manager logs 'Error presenting challenge' and HTTP01 challenges fail.
consequence.remediation: Disable strict-validate-path-type in ingress-nginx or otherwise adjust it, per the release notes.

assertion.statement: ACME HTTP01 Ingress challenge paths now use PathType Exact instead of ImplementationSpecific, which is incompatible with ingress-nginx >=1.8.0 when strict-validate-path-type is enabled (default in >=1.12.0), causing the admission webhook to deny the challenge Ingress.
